title.zh: Aptos Unveils Tokenomics Overhaul: 210M APT to Be Permanently Locked, Staking Re
title.en: Aptos Unveils Tokenomics Overhaul: 210M APT to Be Permanently Locked, Staking Re

current_state.zh: Aptos Foundation proposed cutting staking rewards from 5.19% to 2.6%, raising gas fees tenfold, capping supply at 2.1 billion APT, permanently locking and staking 210 million APT, and tying grants to milestones while considering a buyback to cut emissions and make APT potentially deflationary.
